# Vocabulary: multiplayer

Supported social play modes.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `single` | Single-player | One player. |
| `coop` | Co-op | Players share one simulation toward shared goals. |
| `competitive` | Competitive | Players compete directly in one simulation or match. |
| `persistent-mmo` | Persistent MMO | Many players in a persistent server-side world. |
| `async-shared` | Async / shared content | Players affect each other asynchronously via shared content, markets, or regions. |
